digest.component_or_area: backend abstraction layer / comment reconciliation paths
propositions: Core backend-neutral modules (outbound_comments.py, inbound_translate.py) contain literal lazy-load keys to Jira-specific adapters (adapters.jira.adf, adapters.jira.comment_limits), causing vendor code to execute unconditionally for any configured backend.
Comment formatting and truncation on the outbound-diff path must be routed through FieldSanitizer.fit_comment() instead of lazy-loading adapters.jira.comment_limits directly.
Inbound ADF decoding and normalization must be routed through InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text() instead of lazy-loading adapters.jira.adf at literal key _ADF_KEY_APPLIER.

The public function inbound_translate._normalize_adf_body must remain importable and callable by apply_inbound_records.py and re-exported by applier.py, but must delegate to the backend port instead of vendor modules.
Acceptance gate: no package-root core module (except recorded exemption inbound_fields.py) may contain the string literal rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira, verified by a new test sweep case.
